quests.title: Prepare Yorick's visit after the first burial

storySteps.title: Prime Yorick's visit after the first burial
Reach five Graveyard quality and open the Church
Deliver the first sermon and finish Bishop's tutorial
Meet Donkey after the Church opens
Hear Gerry after the Church opens
Receive the Bishop's bowl request
Bring twenty ceramic bowls to the Bishop
Raise the Graveyard and Church quality and bring the Bishop fish
Give the Bishop the building permission and upgrade the Church
Receive the Bishop's first Big Church briefing
Deliver the rightful-citizen papers and reopen preaching
Hear the Bishop's optional town-cathedral lore
Receive the Church and Graveyard requirements for the Cathedral
Reach fifty Church quality for the Cathedral
Reach two hundred Graveyard quality for the Cathedral
Receive the Bishop's statue request in the Graveyard
Erect the Bishop's marble statue
Upgrade the Big Church to the Cathedral
Hear Gerry after the Cathedral upgrade
Hear Gerry after obtaining the Aristocrat Papers
Present the aristocrat papers to the Bishop
Secure the Inquisitor's agreement to attend the ceremony
Unlock the Merchant's Cathedral topic once he has revealed his dream
Obtain the Merchant's accepted invitation for the Cathedral ceremony
Deliver the Merchant's accepted invitation to the Bishop
Hold the final Cathedral ceremony for the Bishop and Merchant
Buy the one-time civic tiers, documents, and route-exclusive story tokens from Royal Services
